messages:
ana: Quick recap from this morning's enterprise roundtable (PulseMD, RelayAI): unanimous ask = per-route cost visibility + a one-click error->trace path. They said they can tolerate a short retention window if the surface is actionable. I'm suggesting a tight launch slice to unblock them quickly.

logan: Agreed. Small, testable surface. Can we define an MVP that gives useful numbers but keeps infra work minimal?

mira: Proposal: concise-v1 slice: 
- UI: "Route snapshot" card (7d) showing top routes by token spend + trend sparkline. Error table that includes an "open trace" action.
- Data: emit trace_id in metrics envelope at emit-time so the UI resolves trace by id (no extra trace copies). Sampling default 0.2% global, tenant override for Dedicated.
- Export: delta CSV export (incremental rows) for easy reconciliation; events webhook alpha for cost spikes (threshold-based rules).

devin: Engineering notes: trace_id in metrics is the cheapest route. We'll need a lightweight index mapping trace_id -> trace_url for the UI click. Estimates:
- trace_id plumbing + URL lookup: 5 dev-days
- route snapshot UI + delta CSV endpoint: 3 dev-days
- webhook prototype + rules integration: 2 dev-days
- infra indexing + small retention flag: 3 dev-days
Total ~13 dev-days across infra + runtime squads.

logan: Acceptance gates (proposal):
1) Accuracy: route snapshot within 3% vs billing on top-10 routes over a 7d window.
2) UX: open-trace resolves to the correct trace in <=1.5s for sampled traces >=93% of the time.
3) Perf: snapshot query p95 <450ms under normal query load.
4) Reliability: delta CSV export success >=99% in canary.
5) Security/privacy: audit signoff and "estimated" label linking to billing.

mira: Tests: billing-replay harness to validate the 3% gate, e2e clicking open-trace that validates trace_url resolution, and telemetry events: route_snapshot_view, csv_delta_download, trace_open_click, spike_alert_fired. Add a feature flag and immediate kill-switch.

product-bot: Created ticket RD-60123: "console: concise-v1 observability slice (route snapshot + trace-link + delta CSV + webhook alpha)" assigned to @devin, due 2026-04-28. :robot_face:

cs_bot: Pilot cohort suggested: internal + PulseMD + RelayAI + BetaLabs. Use feature flag redwood.obs_concise_v1.

ana: Decision: ship concise-v1 as described. Defer full per-route explorer and longer retention windows to a follow-up quarter. Action items:
- devin: split RD-60123 into subtasks + owners + estimates (EOD)
- mira: write acceptance test definitions + billing replay script (Tue)
- logan: coordinate pilot enablement with CS (Mon)
- infra: add index + kill-switch flag (today)
- cs_bot: schedule pilot onboarding calls and collect feedback templates

logan: I'll sync with CS and get PulseMD scheduled. Keeping scope narrow will reduce rollout risk and unblock customers sooner. :+1:

mira: I'll start the billing replay spec and include a small synthetic data set for the 3% gate.

ana: Thanks all. We'll demo an internal build next week and aim for canary after the acceptance tests pass.
